title: Read the Record
prompt: students (a list of dicts) is given in the starter. Print the name of the SECOND student, then their first grade — two lines.

tests.name: reads nested fields
tests.code:
assert len(printed) == 2, f"expected two lines, got {printed}"
assert "Lan" in printed[0], f"second student name, got {printed}"
assert "10" in printed[1], f"first grade of Lan, got {printed}"
